# Cameroon ADM3 residual — proposal only

This local factual packet is a proposed unresolved disposition, not an accepted repair. It covers all 4,925 keys in `gb-CMR-ADM3--repair-evaluation`: 4,892 land and 33 inland-water keys, 2,900 retained interval segments, and 74 original owners. The selected-owner observer is pinned to data and code commit `a122d6d3b098a101b544274cde4142574a02e99b`; it reports base, additive, and effective owner 0 for every key, no owner IDs, and no existing-product overlap. It does not establish qualification. All keys remain unresolved and held with zero owner changes, zero accepted cells, and zero credit.

`cmr-per-key-proposal.jsonl.gz.base64` encodes the complete row packet. Decode with `base64 -d cmr-per-key-proposal.jsonl.gz.base64 | gzip -dc` to read the 4,925-line JSONL. The JSONL rows bind the exact owner/y/x tuple to the original interval segment and physical class, candidate-run result, source-feature index set and identities, retained physical-support run, and the owner-observation zeros. The compact artifact pins, counts, and detailed limits are in `manifest.json`.

The source-feature IDs were resolved from the exact, compressed and decoded hash-verified original feature-part payloads and the pinned raster registry product order/counts. The method maps the global index to a payload ordinal and reads the literal shapeID; no IDs were guessed from names. The separate 1.84 MB feature-roster gzip is pinned, but the response was empty/non-UTF-8 and was not decoded. Therefore the packet reports the exact payload-derived IDs and also preserves that roster retrieval limitation.

The retained catalogue records source-license and represented-year claims for the eight selected families: CAF ADM1/2, CMR ADM1/2/3, GAB ADM1, NGA ADM1, and TCD ADM1. These are historical source metadata, not proof of currentness, rights beyond recorded terms, legal authority, source applicability, or sovereignty. Candidate membership is not geometric contact or current-border evidence. Physical-run membership mirrors the retained queue class; it is not an independent current physical determination. GNQ is excluded from the queried operand set; this is not a no-contact finding, and GNQ-based qualification/publication remains held pending separate source and rights evidence.

No geometry or observer rerun was performed. This packet does not alter owners, accepted repair ledgers, or credit. Next step is independent exact-head review and adopted source-applicability/authority evidence.

limits: Candidate membership and source feature IDs are retained source-raster/candidate evidence; they do not establish present-day applicability, legal authority, or sovereignty.
Physical-support runs establish retained queue run membership by land/water class, not independent current physical qualification.

GNQ is absent from the observer’s selected source_families [50,51,66,67,68,118,237,317]; it was excluded from the queried operand set, so this packet makes no finding about GNQ contact or applicability.
Catalog license and represented-year fields are source metadata only; they do not establish further upstream rights or currentness.

source_raster_registry.note: Registry records 73,567 source features across 368 products; package global source-feature indices were resolved to exact shape IDs from the cited family payload parts and product counts.

source_feature_roster.retrieval_note: Not decoded for this packet (binary response could not be read as UTF-8). Source identity rows were resolved from exact pinned original feature-part blobs and registry feature counts; no IDs were inferred from display names.

row_evidence_encoding.encoding: Base64 of deterministic gzip(JSONL); decode with base64 -d then gzip -dc

administrative_source_registry.pin_role: baseline pin recorded in retained source catalogue; historical metadata only

family_metadata_claims.recorded_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

source_identity_method.input_parts: Exact compressed and decoded SHA-256 verified payloads listed under source_part_oids. Each retained feature index was mapped using the verified raster registry product order and feature counts to its product-part ordinal, then matched to the literal shapeID/shapeName in the exact original payload. No identity was inferred from a name. The separate feature-roster gzip is pinned but was not decoded; its retrieval limitation is recorded.

gnq_handling.finding: GNQ was outside the queried source-family operands and is not assessed for contact or applicability here. Any GNQ-based qualification/publication remains held pending separate source and rights evidence.
